data.name: Kayvan
data.gender_notes: Kayvan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word ‘kavān’, meaning ‘mountain’ or ‘like a mountain’. This name symbolizes strength, stability, and resilience. The name Kayvan carries the meaning “Mountain like” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kayvan usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain like and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the mountain of faith, steadfast in one's beliefs.
data.etymology: Kayvan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain like.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kayvan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
